mechanism_narrative: A sustained low level of federal funds rate indicates an accommodative monetary policy, which tends to boost equity markets by reducing borrowing costs and increasing liquidity.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative more than 50% of the time when FEDFUNDS is below 0.5%, indicating no positive effect.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in unemployment rate above 8.5% signals labor market weakness, which may lead to economic downturn and negative equity returns.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive more than 40% of the time when UNRATE exceeds 8.5%, indicating no negative impact.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent growth in GDP and housing starts indicates strong economic expansion, which is likely to drive positive equity returns.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative when both GDPC1 and HOUST show growth, indicating no positive relationship.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle, an increase in federal funds rate may lead to higher borrowing costs and reduced corporate earnings, causing negative equity returns.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive more than 30% during tightening cycles, indicating no negative impact.

mechanism_narrative: Growth in non-farm payroll employment indicates a strong labor market, which may lead to increased consumer spending and positive equity returns.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative more than 40% when PAYEMS grows, indicating no positive effect.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production below 95 may signal a slowdown in economic activity, leading to negative equity returns.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive more than 30% when INDPRO is below 95, indicating no negative impact.

mechanism_narrative: Low federal funds rate coupled with rising consumer prices may indicate inflationary pressures without monetary tightening, which could lead to positive equity returns.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative when FEDFUNDS is low and CPIAUCSL is rising, indicating no positive relationship.

mechanism_narrative: Retail sales growth during a late-cycle expansion may indicate continued consumer confidence and economic growth, leading to positive equity returns.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative when RSAFS grows in late-cycle, indicating no positive impact.
